name: Hau nuong
summary: Hàu nướng is grilled oyster. A diner in the Dân Việt town story lists hàu among the plates. Thanh Niên shows grilled oysters with cheese and with mỡ hành at Hàng Dương. A recipe was not printed.
origin: Can Gio. Dân Việt, 2 Oct 2022. Thanh Niên, 11 Mar 2019, at chợ hải sản Hàng Dương.
howToEat: Eat it hot, off the shell. Thanh Niên’s two finishes are cheese and mỡ hành.
Thanh Niên prints 50,000 VND for 12 oysters on 11 Mar 2019. A 2026 price is Check on arrival.
where: Chợ hải sản Hàng Dương on đường Thạnh Thới, beside bãi 30 tháng 4. The town streets also serve it. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Hau nuong — grilled oysters at Hang Duong
seoDescription: Grilled oysters at Hàng Dương, with cheese or scallion oil in a 2019 Thanh Niên story. A recipe was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.
